Refresh Browser About this product Product Information If you're searching for a heavy metal guitar sound that's ideal for live performances, consider using the DigiTech X-Series Metal Master distortion effects pedal. This high-quality musical device provides guitarists with three distinct effects sounds, which is great for musicians who have varied performance styles. This well-constructed, versatile pedal is built stand up to the rigors of the road. Touring musicians will find that these pedals make great traveling accessories.The Metal Master pedal features DigiTech's impressive AudioDNA technology. Use it with guitars to create a wide array of distortion sounds and effects. The pedal gives electric guitarists complete control over their style thanks to the device's four separate knobs. The first dial is for Level, which gives users control over the effect's output level. The Low control is used to alter the cut and boost of low frequencies while the High knob controls the cut and boost of high frequencies. To morph between the three metal distortion effects, guitarists use the Morph control. Use this dial to create a smooth high gain tone, a scooped mid-range sound, and a punchy mid-range metal sound. By combining these distinct guitar effects, musicians create a music texture that is unique.DigiTech creates products that help musicians refine and individualize their tone. The X-Series Metal Master has separate low and high spectral-contouring EQ. This means that the device adjusts a broader range of frequencies than many typical stompboxes. These DigiTech pedals also feature dual amp and mixer outputs with optional cabinet modeling circuitry. The pedal's advance CIT cabinet modeling technology ensures that guitarists achieve authentic guitar amplifier sounds, even without amps.These heavy metal distortion pedal accessories are housed in a sturdy metal chassis. It measures approximately 5 x 3 x 2 inches and weighs only 1.38 pounds. The design is an appealing combination of rugged and lightweight. It's sturdy enough to last for years, but it's light enough so that it never weighs down your pedalboard too much. Under the metal chassis, the X-Series Metal Master has all the technical specifications a guitarist could ask for. For example, it has an input impedance of 1M Ohms and an output impedance of 100 Ohms.The pedal is powered by a 9V alkaline dry-cell battery. This power supply provides guitarists with up to four hours of playtime with continuous usage. Replacing the battery is a fairly simple process. After replacing the battery, guitarists should make sure the distortion pedal is properly fastened. Guitarists who don't want to rely on battery power use an alternate power source. These distortion pedals have an AC adapter jack, which is used with a PS200R power supply. The pedals also have an input jack, which is meant to connect with the instrument. When a guitar cable is connected to the input, battery power is immediately engaged. DigiTech recommends that users disconnect cables when the devices are not in use as this saves battery power. This pedal will give you the arsenal you need to tear the heads off of your crowd! Use the Morph knob to morph between a smooth high gain tone, to a scooped midrange sound, all the way to a punchy mid range heavy metal sound that will cut through ANY mix! You strive to make your music unique and DigiTech gives you the power to create that unique sound in one pedal. In order to give you more options than anyone else and further refine your tone, DigiTech put in separate low and high spectral-contouring EQ and dual amp/mixer outputs with optional cabinet modeling circuitry.
